subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored messages by default, with loop protection as the upgrade guard, or should bot-authored Feishu ingress require an explicit opt-in like sibling channels?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable: preserving omitted admission avoids breaking the current Feishu path, while requiring opt-in better matches sibling-channel defaults and reduces surprise bot-loop risk.

options.title: Preserve Admission With Guard
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, rely on self-filter plus botLoopProtection, and document the upgrade behavior clearly.

options.title: Require Explicit Admission
options.body: Change the default so bot-authored Feishu messages are ignored unless allowBots is true or "mentions", trading compatibility for a safer sibling-channel posture.

options.title: Defer Direction
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer writes the desired Feishu bot-admission policy and asks for a narrower implementation refresh.

recommendation.title: Preserve Admission With Guard
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu messages, rely on self-filter plus botLoopProtection, and document the upgrade behavior clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior Feishu mention-cascade guardrail and has recent Feishu docs/source policy history, making him the best available routing owner for the default-policy choice.
